Stop doing git pull --rebase blindly.

Understanding Git worktrees will completely change your multi-branch productivity:
- Keep 3 branches active simultaneously without stash or context switching
- Run tests on staging while writing feature code in another terminal

Command: git worktree add ../feature-branch feature

Try this in your next sprint. Repost if helpful!

Redis Cache Invalidation Strategies you must know for backend interviews:

1. Cache-Aside (Lazy Loading)
2. Write-Through
3. Write-Behind (Write-Back)
4. Refresh-Ahead

Save this cheat sheet for later!

The biggest mistake beginners make in Python asyncio:

Calling synchronous time.sleep() or blocking requests.get() inside an async coroutine.

This completely blocks the event loop. Always use asyncio.sleep() and httpx.AsyncClient.
